groups.title: Shop presses · value line
groups.lead: Motorized workshop presses from 28 to 176 US tons and a hydraulic bench press for sheet-metal tooling — NovoTech value line, built in China.

groups.title: Hydraulic presses · value line
groups.lead: Motorized H-frame, brake, sliding-table, C-frame and four-column presses from 22 to 551 US tons — NovoTech value line, built in China.

groups.title: Orbital riveting machines · value line
groups.lead: Hydraulic orbital riveters that roll solid rivets from 3/16 to 1-3/16″ — NovoTech value line, built in China.

intro_add: NovoTech's value-line presses, built in China, add motorized workshop presses from 28 to 176 US tons, the EBP-10T hydraulic bench press, motorized H-frame presses to 551 US tons, presses with a brake function, sliding-table, C-frame and four-column presses, and XM orbital riveting machines.
points_add: NovoTech value line: workshop presses 28 – 176 US tons, H-frame presses 33 – 551 US tons, brake, sliding-table, C-frame and four-column presses, orbital riveters

faq_add.a: The premium-line shop and production presses are built in Turkey with European hydraulics and Siemens controls, for daily production work, straightening lines and custom sizes. The value-line presses are built in China for the repair shop, the maintenance department and lighter production — the same tonnages at a lower price, with built-on or separate power units.

set.hero_brand_line: Premium-line shop presses are built in Turkey for NovoTech's premium line; the NovoTech premium-line production presses are built in Turkey with European components; the value-line presses are built in China — all to NovoTech's specification and sold, installed and supported in Canada by NovoTech.
